messages:
elaine: Thanks everyone for joining today 12 — quick follow-up thread for Q&A bits we promised to publish. I captured highlights below; please flag anything I missed.

ops-bot: Recording + slides posted: https://redwood.cloud/ah/1748009999/recording  Slides: https://drive.redwood/teams/all-hands/1748009999/slides

maria: TL;DR posted in drive and pinned here. Also added a link to the feedback form.

jonathan: Roadmap clarity question: wecommit to the Dedicated GA window of "early Q3" but will ship via staged canaries (internal partners then selected customers). Ill publish the phased rollout checklist and canary criteria. Owner: jonathan. Target: 2024-05-12.

tara: On the SLAs thread — sales & support will follow up with customers who asked for SLA specifics. Tara to coordinate templates and a comms plan. ETA: 2024-05-05.

kai: Observability ask: longer retention tiers for traces and per-route token-cost retention. Ill propose retention tiers, pricing sketch, and a migration guide for customers. Owner: kai. ETA: 2024-05-04.

devex: SDK compatibility and deprecation question: were keeping major-semver guarantees. Devex will publish a deprecation timeline + migration recipes (python/js examples). Owner: devex. ETA: 2024-04-30.

maria: Compact action list I added to the follow-up doc:
```
- Jonathan: publish Dedicated phased-rollout doc + canary criteria (due 2024-05-12)
- Kai: observability retention tiers + pricing draft (due 2024-05-04)
- Tara: SLA comms templates + customer follow-ups (due 2024-05-05)
- Devex: SDK deprecation timeline + migration recipes (due 2024-04-30)
- Maria: publish TL;DR & pin assets (done)
```

jonathan: Ack  Ill post the rollout checklist and tag eng/product/sales by EOD tomorrow.

kai: Ack  creating a retention folder now and will link the doc here when ready.

tara: Opening a small comms working group and will invite reps from sales/solutions/support.

elaine: If you asked a question during the live Q&A and it didn't get a response, reply here and we'll queue it for leadership to answer. Also: if you see blockers to the stated ETAs, please call them out now so we can adjust. Thanks all for the fast follow-up. :heart:
